name: Lady Hardinge Medical College
evidence: The official government site identifies Lady Hardinge Medical College under the Government of India’s Department of Health & Family Welfare, and its History page calls it a medical college for women.
notes: The supplied https://www.lhmc.edu.in hostname returned DNS NXDOMAIN; the evidence comes from the current official government domain https://lhmc-hosp.gov.in, which names the same institute.
